text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Aston Machan got injured, so I rushed her 
to the infirmary, but... She's looking 
down, seemingly depressed.
choice_data_list: Chan, if you get some rest, I'm sure—

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: No, I want to start rehab right away.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
"...Machan was watching. At Mom's 
hospital... seeing everyone doing their 
best."

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
"Ma-chan won't give up either. Whatever 
rehab it is, bring it on."
choice_data_list: As long as it's within reason...

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
choice_data_list:
Rehabilitating on your own judgment is 
dangerous.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
! ...Come to think of it, my mother often 
said the same thing to patients who pushed 
themselves too hard.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Chan made a careless mistake. It seems 
Chan was rushing a little bit.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Understood. Well then, let's do a little 
bit of exercise at the gym.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
I sensed a tiny bit of bad vibes just now. 
It seems a tactical retreat is in order.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
"...So everyone back then was feeling this 
kind of frustration too, weren't they...?"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Afterward, Aston Machan had to take a 
break and rest for a while...

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
How about that? Nothing is impossible for 
a mascot who never gives up! Ahem.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Afterward, thanks to her proactive 
rehabilitation, Aston Machan was able to 
make a smooth and successful comeback.
